computer_code: {device} made a pairing code for the computer “{name}”
computer_joining: A new computer, “{name}”, wants to join. Open the app to confirm it’s yours
confirmed_computer: This computer is already confirmed. To pair it again, make the code on the hub’s admin page or on the hub’s machine
invalid_os: os must be mac, linux or windows
mesh_member: This hub is a member of a hub group. Add the computer on the center hub
tls_required: The hub hasn’t turned on secure connections yet, so computers can’t connect
too_many_pending: {count} computers you added aren’t set up yet (some may never have connected). Remove the ones you don’t need before adding another
unknown_machine: There’s no computer “{id}” that connects to the hub
